official_references.official_effect_text:
3 Level 5 monsters
(This card is always treated as "Number C39: Utopia Ray".)
[b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]: [b]You can[/b] detach 1 material from this card; equip 1 "ZW -" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck to this card as if it were equipped by that monster's effect. This effect's activation [b]and[/b] effect [b]cannot[/b] be negated. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], while this card is equipped with a "ZW -" Monster Card ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; [b]negate[/b] its effects, [b]and if you do[/b], halve its ATK.
The equipped monster gains 800 ATK/DEF for each face-up monster you control.

If your opponent controls 3 or more monsters and you control a Level 5 or higher Illusion monster: Target up to 3 cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If you control a Level 5 or higher Illusion monster and this card is in your GY: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use 1 "Sinful Spoils Awakening" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
